projectionCredentials.http: host.restart remains a CLI-owned composition and returns SNAPBACK_HOST_OP_CLI_ONLY over HTTP; its stop leg is the separately served AdminWrite host.stop operation.
projectionCredentials.cli: snapback stop and snapback restart resolve a concrete owner-only admin token and send only startupNonce to authenticated host.stop; before the request the caller binds the descriptor PID to that health-matching nonce and its OS process-table start time, then validates the exact typed operation/target/declared-authority/self-stop result and records configured-URL health loss separately. Top-level success is granted only when signal-0 ESRCH or a different start time after PID reuse proves the original descriptor-named identity gone; processIdentityVerified claims exactly that observation, not HTTP responder authentication. Restart launches the recorded-serverProfile successor only after this stop verdict. Same-UID responder identity is not distinguishable; no descriptor PID enters a signal, request, or stop receipt (crates/snapback-cli/src/cli.rs host_stop_result/host_restart_result/authenticated_server_stop/wait_for_lifecycle_stop_observations).
projectionCredentials.mcp: snapback_stop (and therefore snapback_restart's mutating half) requires an admin token accepted by the host-ops route and delegates to the same native credentialed-result, configured-URL, and descriptor-named identity-bound exit observations. The fresh-spawn leg has no prior server credential to hold.

storage.protected-erasure.note: LLP 0184 storage-owner classification (2026-08-06): POST /_snapback/api/storage/protected-erasure erases one identified row (qualified_table + row_id), gated by re-validating a concrete admin credential inside the same synchronous commit window and a fenced-authority publication (LLP 0165 protected-deletion-authority-audit). A narrowly-scoped, legitimate operator erasure capability, not system-internal plumbing — an agent should be able to discover and invoke it, but the row it deletes is irreversible and likely privacy/compliance-sensitive, so approvalPosture is humanApprovalRequired rather than a bare confirmFirst. apiOnly stands: no CLI/MCP tool exists yet. Rule-5 completion (2026-08-06, memo-verified): exact retries with the same operationId/authority/target are idempotent and resume open checkpoint-destruction obligations; divergent reuse refuses; the deletion, fence, and receipt persist across restart (LLP 0165 crash/reopen record). Invocation recipe: guide anchor above.

storage.operation-coverage.activate.note: LLP 0184 storage-owner classification (2026-08-06): POST /_snapback/api/storage/operation-coverage/activate activates a coverage manifest for a target/coverage profile (LLP 0162 managed-branch row-4 publication). InvocationSource::OperationCoverageActivation resolves to the ordinary admin credential class, not a system-internal-only source, and the route is ResponseSensitivity::OperatorMetadata rather than destructive — ordinary operator maintenance, ordinarily agent-invokable. apiOnly stands: no CLI/MCP tool exists yet. Rule-5 completion (2026-08-06, memo-verified): accepts only the v1 local-dev-sqlite-ibex / local-envelope-mapped-writers.v1 pair; exact repeat returns the same active manifest; the manifest persists and re-arms on database open. Success does NOT publish the AgentSafe capability or waive LLP 0162/0163 gates. targets [local] is a discovery fact (request contract exposes only the local target; handler does not yet compare declared target with derived identity) — invocation admission stays authoritative per §Design/1.

auth.mailbox.read.pinReason: CredentialSecret responseSensitivity + ImpersonationCapability-adjacent effect: usage-evidence promotion to native/cliOnly/mcpOnly is refused outright per §Product contract's promotion-refusal rule, regardless of call volume. An authored override, not a threshold, is the only way past this pin, and only after passing the same secret-carrier review config.set requires.
auth.mailbox.read.note: src/server.rs's route_registry() exports this row directly: GET /_snapback/api/auth/mailbox, AdminWrite policy, CredentialSecret responseSensitivity. The compiler's promotion-refusal check keys off this exact policy fact from the live export, not this override file, so this entry documents intent rather than driving enforcement.
